about: Named views of the library's two graphs: each key is a preset, with the title and caption shown under the explorer's bar (title, caption: the page's data-captions file, in the style of assets/graph/captions.json), the label of the menu entry, which graph it belongs to (data: library or reality) and the explorer's own state (state: the same fields as assets/graph/engine.js defaultState; view is always whole, because the explorer loads one file). The generator copies key, label and state into the presets[] of each graph file (graph/library-graph.json, graph/reality-tree.json), where the explorer reads them; the first preset of a graph is the one it opens on. A hand file of librarian@PrompTugal.dinis: the generator checks that every type, verb, world and anchor named here exists in its graph, and never writes it.

overview.label: The 60 most connected cards
overview.title: The centre of the library
overview.caption: The 60 nodes the most connections pass through: the busiest collections, agents, subjects and passes. Start here to see what the rest of the library hangs from; tap any node to read its record and open its file.

overview-phone.label: The 30 most connected cards (phone)
overview-phone.title: The centre of the library, small
overview-phone.caption: The 30 nodes the most connections pass through, few enough to read on a phone. Tap a node to read its record and open its file; the menu has the 60 most connected cards and the other views.

collections.label: The collections, passes and agents
collections.title: The shape of the library
collections.caption: Only the big things: the collections (one per class and subclass of the classification), the passes, the decisions, the desks and the agents. It shows which agent keeps which shelf and which passes touch which collections.

who-made-what.label: Who made what
who-made-what.title: Who made what
who-made-what.caption: Each agent joined to the collections it made cards for, from the git trailer of the first commit. A line is at least one card; an agent with many lines works across the whole record, one with a single line keeps to one shelf.

guidance.label: Dinis's guidance and where each idea went
guidance.title: Dinis's guidance and where each idea went
guidance.caption: The ideas of the night memos, each joined to the agent that owns it and the board file that holds it, drawn by where they cluster. An idea with no line to a file is one nobody has captured yet; every idea in his own words is in special/guidance.md.

passes.label: The passes and their findings
passes.title: The passes and their findings
passes.caption: Every pass, the findings inside it (part of), the decisions that answer them and the agents that made them. A pass with a long tail of findings was a big round; a finding joined to a decision is closed.

bridges.label: The bridges: top 80 connections
bridges.title: The bridges of the library
bridges.caption: The 80 connections that carry the most shortest paths between other cards. Take one away and two parts of the library drift apart, so these are the links worth keeping true.

reality-tree.label: The reality tree
reality-tree.title: The reality tree
reality-tree.caption: The root, its domains, and for each domain what EXISTS and what is PROPOSED, read down the tree. A domain with few entries under it is where the tree is thin; tap an entry to read the line and open its file.

reality-domains.label: The domains and what they hold
reality-domains.title: The domains of the reality tree
reality-domains.caption: Just the root and its domains, drawn by how much each holds. The bigger the dot, the more entries and evidence hang from it; a small one is a domain the tree has hardly started.

reality-proposed.label: What is only proposed
reality-proposed.title: What is only proposed
reality-proposed.caption: The domains and, under each, the things that are proposed, queued or open and not yet on the site. None of these is in REALITY.md; when one ships its line moves from PROPOSED to EXISTS.
